grades.reason: Describes access effects of undefined or unimplemented CSRs. It does not explain how to modify selected bits while preserving other fields.

grades.quote: The initial value in integer register _rs1_ is treated as a bit mask that specifies bit positions to be set in the CSR. Any bit that is high in _rs1_ will cause the corresponding bit to be set in the CSR, if that CSR bit is writable.
grades.reason: Directly answers the query. CSRRS and CSRRC use an rs1 bit mask to atomically set or clear only the selected CSR bits, and the immediate forms do the same. Other bits are left unchanged, unlike CSRRW, which overwrites the whole CSR.
Lists the fields of the mctrctl register and which are optional or writable. It says nothing about a method for changing selected bits without overwriting others.
